_real_world.class: AESA fire-control radar, designation not officially disclosed; probably the same radar fitted to the land-based J-11D
_real_world.variant_scope: J-15T carrier-based Flanker-derivative multirole fighter nose radar, replacing the baseline J-15's mechanically-scanned Type 1493 pulse-Doppler set
public_equipment: New AESA radar behind a canted, pitot-less radome (TWZ, The Aviationist); 'probably the same as used on the J-11D' (TWZ); radar confirmed compatible with PL-10/PL-15 (TWZ)

_provenance.modeling_note: Primary fire-control radar for J-15T per the task's requirement. TWZ (Tier B) confirms the J-15T carries a new AESA behind a distinctively canted, pitot-less radome, assessed as probably identical to the J-11D's AESA, and confirms weapon compatibility (PL-10/PL-15) but publishes no detection-range or scan-performance figures — no PRC disclosure exists. max_range is an engineering_estimate proxy set slightly below the CSG_CN_J-35_AESA record (a full 5th-generation, purpose-designed stealth-fighter radar) and close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79 (150 km, contemporary Western carrier-fighter AESA), reflecting that the J-15T's AESA is a retrofit onto a 4.5-generation Flanker-derivative airframe rather than a clean-sheet 5th-generation design. All scan/track/noise parameters are proxies patterned on the repo CSG_US_APG-79 and this packet's CSG_CN_J-35_AESA records; no public figures exist for any of them.

sensor.max_range.note: engineering_estimate 160 km; TWZ confirms an AESA fit (probably J-11D-derived) but publishes no range figure. Set close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79's 150 km, slightly above reflecting the AESA's newer generation than the baseline Type 1493

sensor.fov_deg.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_APG-79/CSG_CN_J-35_AESA pattern; no public figure

sensor.scan_period.note: proxy close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79's 1.0 s; no public figure

sensor.detection_prob.note: proxy close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79's 0.92, nudged down slightly given the total absence of independent performance corroboration; no public figure

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_APG-79 pattern, nudged up marginally reflecting a retrofit installation vs a clean-sheet design; no public figure

sensor.range_noise_std.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_APG-79 pattern, nudged up marginally, same basis as bearing_noise_std; no public figure

sensor.track_memory_s.note: proxy copied from the repo CSG_US_APG-79 pattern; no public figure

sensor.range_power.note: proxy copied unchanged (radar-equation exponent, not platform-specific)

sensor.aspect_influence.note: proxy close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79 pattern; no public figure

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: proxy close to the repo CSG_US_APG-79 pattern; no public figure
